No install beyond the [`duckdb`](https://duckdb.org/docs/installation/)
binary itself — no Python, no R, no account.

## Attach and query

```sh
duckdb -c "
INSTALL iceberg; LOAD iceberg;
ATTACH 'canceronice' AS coi (TYPE ICEBERG, ENDPOINT 'https://icegate-canceronice.seandavi.workers.dev', AUTHORIZATION_TYPE 'none');
SELECT source, count(*) FROM coi.measure.observation WHERE valid_to IS NULL GROUP BY source ORDER BY source;
"
```

Drop `-c "..."` for an interactive shell (`duckdb`), then paste the `INSTALL`/
`ATTACH` block once per session and query freely — `coi` stays attached for
the rest of that shell.

Piping to a file works the same as any other DuckDB output:

```sh
duckdb -c "ATTACH 'canceronice' AS coi (...); COPY (SELECT * FROM coi.measure.definition) TO 'measures.csv';"
```
